gaps.explanation: Re-read pp4-5, 15-17. Statement total receipts 27,077,032 (p4) = General 17,030,017 + Road/Bridge 3,131,085 + COVID ARPA 0 + Law Enforcement Center 0 + Other Governmental Funds 6,915,930. Schedule revenue 45,368,945 = General 17,030,017 + Road/Bridge 3,131,085 (tie) + Law Enforcement Center Fund budgetary schedule (p15) 'Proceeds from sale of bonds' 18,291,916 + Nonmajor Funds budgetary schedule (pp16-17) receipt rows 6,915,927. (1) Law Enforcement Center Fund: the budget schedule (p15) prints its only receipt row, 'Proceeds from sale of bonds' 18,291,916, under RECEIPTS; the statement prints the same money under OTHER FINANCING SOURCES (p5, LEC column: Premium 1,051,759 + Issuance costs (264,843) + Proceeds 17,505,000 = 18,291,916), so the statement has 0 receipts for this fund. Printed as a receipt on the schedule; it is not counted twice in detail (the p5 rows are not in detail) - kept as printed, gap -18,291,916. (2) Nonmajor: the 17 non-transfer receipt rows on pp16-17 sum to 6,915,927 (TOTAL RECEIPTS 6,926,526 less Transfers in 7,000 + 3,599, which detail holds under other financing); the statement Other Governmental Funds column prints 6,915,930 (Intergovernmental 726,474 vs schedule State/Federal/Local 726,473; Miscellaneous 860,252 vs 393,036 + 467,214 = 860,250; Taxes 5,313,875 and Charges 15,329 tie): a 3 rounding difference printed in the report. Nothing missing, nothing duplicated. 45,368,945 - 18,291,916 + 3 = 27,077,032.
